Photograph: NDLEA Basketball US basketball player arrested with 75lb of marijuana at Nigerian airport, say authorities
 Suspect named as Greene Da’monte Khiree
 Drug smuggling carries life sentence in Nigeria
 Guardian sport Mon 16 Nov 2026 08.16 EST Last modified on Mon 16 Nov 2026 09.57 EST Share Prefer the Guardian on Google An American basketball player has been arrested in Nigeria for allegedly attempting to smuggle 33.95kg (75lb) of marijuana into the country.
 Nigeria’s National Drug Law Enforcement Agency (NDLEA) said a 28-year-old player named as Greene Da’monte Khiree from the state of Georgia was arrested at Lagos’s main airport last Wednesday after he arrived on a flight from Thailand via the United Arab Emirates.
 US basketball player Jarred Shaw escaped execution in Indonesia, but his prison ordeal continues Read more The NDLEA said the player told them he had come to Nigeria to “build networks” for his basketball career. The agency said evidence on his phone suggested he had “knowledge of and involvement in the drug trafficking activity”. The NDLEA said it detained the player when he attempted to leave the airport with his hand luggage after abandoning two checked-in bags. The agency said those two bags were found to contain 32 parcels of marijuana, and a tracking device.
 Nigeria has strict drug laws, and trafficking carries a sentence of life in prison.
 A basketball player by the name of Damonte Greene is listed on the roster of the Pattani Raptors in the Thai Premier Men’s League. Greene, a Georgia native, played college basketball for Reinhardt University and South Georgia Technical College. He played semi-professional basketball in the US before representing a number of teams in Thailand.
 WNBA star Brittney Griner and former Utah State player Jarred Shaw were imprisoned in Russia and Indonesia respectively for marijuana offenses. Griner was released in December 2022, while Shaw remains in prison .
